suite.name: release
suite.description: Release measurement, about 60 minutes a build: the screen with all 256 prompts, eight streams as well, Poisson arrivals at 0.7 requests/s (about 80% of sixteen streams' rate) with goodput under a 2 s time to first token and 100 ms per output token, decode stalls while a cold 131K prompt prefills at three depths of the sixteen slots (3 and 11 streams, with short probes sent 2-14 s into it, whose time to first token is what a new conversation waits; 15 streams, which fills every slot during the prefill), and real-text prefill from 32K to 1M. Its grid needs the dev-mode collective RPC.
